# Wikimedia Commons

> > Wikimedia Commons is a free media repository hosting millions of freely usable images, sounds, videos, and other multimedia files contributed by volunteers worldwide.

Wikimedia Commons serves as the central media library for Wikipedia, Wikivoyage, Wikidata, and other Wikimedia projects. The repository features organized galleries and categories covering geographic locations, historical figures, cultural landmarks, architecture, natural phenomena, and educational content under Creative Commons and public domain licenses.

## Key Topics

- Free media repository
- Creative Commons licensing
- Community-uploaded content
- Featured content and galleries
- Geographic and cultural documentation
- Wikipedia media integration
- Wikidata connections
- Multilingual support (Esperanto, Polish, Turkish, French)
- Historical photography and archives
- Architectural heritage
- UNESCO World Heritage Sites
- European cities and landmarks
- Public domain materials
- Educational multimedia resources
- International cultural heritage

## Main Pages

- [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org): Homepage of free media repository featuring Padma River, Bangladesh
- [Ĉefpaĝo (Esperanto)](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/%C4%88efpa%C4%9Do): Esperanto homepage for Wikimedia Commons free media repository

## European Architecture & Landmarks

- [Øresund Bridge](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/%C3%98resund_bridge): Combined road-rail bridge connecting Denmark and Sweden via Øresund
- [Ålesund](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/%C3%85lesund): Photo gallery of Ålesund, Norway featuring Art Nouveau architecture
- [Úbeda](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/%C3%9Abeda): UNESCO World Heritage Site featuring Renaissance architecture in Spain
- [Ōsaka Castle](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/%C5%8Csaka_Castle): Historic Osaka Castle fortress in Chūō-ku, Japan landmark collection
- [Šibenik](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/%C5%A0ibenik): Croatian Dalmatian city Šibenik in Šibenik-Knin County collection

## European Cities & Regions

- [Łódź](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/%C5%81%C3%B3d%C5%BA): Media repository for Łódź, central Poland voivodeship capital city
- [İzmit](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/%C4%B0zmit): Turkish city gallery featuring İzmit in Kocaeli Province museums & parks
- [Şanlıurfa](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/%C5%9Eanl%C4%B1urfa): Southeastern Anatolia city Şanlıurfa (Edessa) in Turkey media
- [Álava-Araba](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/%C3%81lava-Araba): Category page for Álava-Araba province in Basque Country, Spain
- [Žory](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/%C5%BBory): Silesian city Žory heraldry, coat of arms, and municipal symbols

## Cultural Heritage & History

- [Émile Zola](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/%C3%89mile_Zola): Gallery of Émile Zola portraits, works, and 19th-century literary media
- [École polytechnique](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/%C3%89cole_polytechnique): Media collection for École polytechnique, French engineering school
- [Ólavsøka](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/%C3%93lavs%C3%B8ka): Faroe Islands national holiday celebration in Tórshavn with traditions
- [Československo / Česko-Slovensko](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/%C4%8Ceskoslovensko_/_%C4%8Cesko-Slovensko): Historical Czechoslovakia federation dissolved in 1993, Central Europe
- [Żelazowa Wola](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/%C5%BBelazowa_Wola): Polish village in Masovian Voivodeship, Sochaczew County location

## Optional

- [Île Clipperton](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/%C3%8Ele_Clipperton): Media about Clipperton Island, uninhabited French Pacific atoll
- [Über deutsche Rechtschreibung (Karl Klaunig)](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/%C3%9Cber_deutsche_Rechtschreibung_(Karl_Klaunig)): 1867 German orthography publication by Karl Klaunig from Leipzig
- [Β (Greek Letter Beta)](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/%CE%92): Greek letter Beta variants, typography, and writing system evolution
